status: unpinned; est_* fields and totals are researcher estimates, measured values live in page-stats.json; sha256 is filled by `scribe-eval fetch-corpus --pin`

field_notes.confirmed: true = WebFetch of the exact PDF url returned a PDF in this session (resolves). Landing-page identity checks are tracked separately in identity_verified.
field_notes.pages_source: pdf_linearization = page count read from the PDF linearization /N (or /Count) during fetch; estimate = could not read it, figure is from knowledge.
field_notes.scan_with_ocr_layer: true/false/unknown; for old scans only. 'unknown' means the PDF has Font resources next to 1-bit CCITT page images (likely a hidden OCR layer) but the text layer was not directly inspected.
field_notes.identity_verified: true = title/year confirmed on an official landing page or search result; false = identity rests on URL naming and prior knowledge.
field_notes.ingest_file: the file in fixtures/corpus-gov/ that is ingested: <id>.pdf (the original) or <id>.raster.pdf (derived image-only copy)
field_notes.derived: null, or {kind: rasterized-image-only, dpi, source_sha256, sha256} for a derived copy; sha256 is the derived file's
field_notes.totals: researcher estimates only; see page-stats.json for measured totals
